coordinate_convention: doubled E8 roots; inner product is coordinate dot product divided by 4
line_order: integer roots: i<j lexicographic, +2 at i and +2 then -2 at j; then first-coordinate +1 sign roots, tail signs +1 before -1, even total negatives
live_domain: all 120 source root lines except the eight punctured lines
ordered_mask: G(r,s) is even, including every diagonal and both orientations of every orthogonal pair
factor_supports: both factors of each term lie inside the same assigned co-star
